target: Test a newly documented R >=4.3 as.character.POSIXt() midnight serialization mechanism in an exact Dryad original 12h DBF; distinguish strong formatting evidence from proof of author export pipeline.

external_primary_evidence.claim: R Core team discussion shows in R 4.3.1 as.character.POSIXt for exact midnight becomes YYYY-MM-DD rather than YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00; mixed vector retains timestamps for non-midnight values
Data authored with R BBMM workflow; README says MT timestamps and EPSG3742
12h input is subsampled at about 00/01 and 12/13 Mountain Time; no guarantee of actual 00:00 or R data-export version
Official named code requires POSIXct and transforms source GPS to user-supplied population grid CRS; it is NOT a frozen pipeline for producing Dryad input shapefile

hypotheses.predicts: No full HH:MM:SS suffix of exact 00:00:00 exists, because those actual midnight values would be serialized to YYYY-MM-DD; complete timestamps with nonmidnight values are retained. Data pattern supports mechanism but does not prove user ran this transformation.
Date-only timestamps may represent genuinely missing time; other complete records may or may not include midnight; under this mechanism the missing value cannot be filled without provenance.
A different export/serialization path could yield the same observed date-only strings; observing R's pattern is not causal identification.

allowed_input_only_aggregates: Count exact date-only strings YYYY-MM-DD; full datetime strings YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; other/malformed strings
Count complete strings with HH:MM:SS == 00:00:00 (critical R43 prediction), and complete HH:MM:SS == 01:00:00, 12:00:00, 13:00:00

Count complete hour 00 with nonzero minute or second; aggregate histogram of full timestamp (hour,minute,second) patterns, but export ONLY hour-wise counts, minutes/seconds-zero totals and overall midnight-exact absence; no dates/IDs

Within prior group key, number of date-only records with immediately consecutive complete 12-hour-like fixes and number of source-record groups with mixed complete and date-only timestamp representations
Under an explicitly hypothetical date-only == 00:00:00, count nonduplicated within-group timestamps, and within 10–14h successive intervals, retaining the previously frozen source ordering
stop_if: Exact SHA mismatch or ZIP unsafe
unexpected physical field header or timestamp strings
too few timestamps to diagnose mechanism

criteria.timezone_and_DST: unresolved, neither R character default nor local clock conversion determines absolute UTC

prohibitions: No migration corridor EOG or BBMM score
No geometry, no source coordinate data
No committed raw GPS/animal IDs/dates/source values
No automatic filling of date-only values in preexisting original source
Do not rewrite original QC STOP or prior conditional clock-world receipts
